recognize_zh: 視野中兩顆小至中型淋巴球，核圓、染色質濃縮，細胞質量中等且偏向一側，邊緣長出短而細的絨毛狀突起（polar villous projections），是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的絨毛淋巴球；突起集中於一極而非環繞整圈，可與毛細胞白血病區分。
features: Small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei and condensed, clumped chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Moderate amount of basophilic cytoplasm, slightly eccentric
Short, fine cytoplasmic villous projections concentrated at one pole or part of the cell border
A third similar lymphoid cell at the left edge and another at the lower edge
Background red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; few platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells and several small to medium lymphoid cells. The lymphoid cells have round nuclei with condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm bearing short villous projections that are predominantly polar rather than circumferential. No prominent nucleoli or plasmacytoid features are identified. Findings are consistent with circulating villous lymphocytes of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; confirmation requires flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal CD5-negative, CD10-negative, CD103-negative B-cell population.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections, more abundant pale cytoplasm and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with spongy chromatin.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: These cells have a single conspicuous central nucleolus and circumferential villi, unlike the inconspicuous nucleoli here.
CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm and block-like clumped chromatin without cytoplasmic projections, and smudge cells are common.

ddx.dx: Drying or spreading artifact of normal lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Artifactual crenation affects cells at the thin edge of the smear and is irregular, whereas true villous lymphocytes are reproducible across the monolayer.
